subject.title: Proof stack for generated media wake-false fallback

question: Is the remaining proof target for this draft a successful Telegram Desktop baseline/candidate artifact, or should maintainers stop using the stacked branch and decide the split PRs separately?
rationale: Automation cannot decide whether skipped Mantis evidence is enough for this internal delivery path or whether the temporary stack should remain open when the final merge boundary is explicitly meant to be split.

options.title: Require Combined Telegram Proof
options.body: Keep this draft non-landing until a redacted Telegram Desktop artifact, live output, or logs show baseline missing or blocking the marker image and the candidate delivering exactly one image.

options.title: Decide Split PRs Separately
options.body: Close or ignore this stack after using the available evidence, and review the implementation and harness PRs on their own proof records.

options.title: Accept Combined Boundary
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally merge the stack only if they want one combined implementation plus proof-harness landing and accept the bundled delivery and automation risk.

recommendation.title: Require Combined Telegram Proof
recommendation.body: Keep this draft non-landing until a redacted Telegram Desktop artifact, live output, or logs show baseline missing or blocking the marker image and the candidate delivering exactly one image.

likelyOwner.reason: The open decision is mainly about Telegram/Mantis proof sufficiency and proof-runner behavior, where recent history points most strongly to this owner path.
